title: Protozoology
modules: Ecology, Physiology And Biochemistry Of Protozoa
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a fundamental component in recycling essential nutrients (nitrogen and phosphorus) to the phytoplankton."
The protozoans are a fundamental component in recycling essential nutrients (nitrogen and phosphorus) to the phytoplankton.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a group of flagellated protozoa."
The trichomonads are a group of flagellated protozoa.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common mechanism of transmission."
Contaminated water is the most common mechanism of transmission.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of several species that cause cryptosporidiosis, a parasitic disease of the mammalian intestinal tract."
Cryptosporidium parvum is one of several species that cause cryptosporidiosis, a parasitic disease of the mammalian intestinal tract.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the disease caused by Toxoplasma parasite."
Toxoplasmosis is the disease caused by Toxoplasma parasite.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known about the pathophysiology associated with T. vaginalis infection, but is presumably due to interactions between the parasite and host epithelial cells."
Little is known about the pathophysiology associated with T. vaginalis infection, but is presumably due to interactions between the parasite and host epithelial cells.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a protozoan parasite in the Phylum Apicomplexa."
Isospora belli is a protozoan parasite in the Phylum Apicomplexa.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the principal host, although dogs, cats and rodents may be infected."
Humans are the principal host, although dogs, cats and rodents may be infected.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the disease caused by Leishmania (True or False) 3."
Leishmaniasis is the disease caused by Leishmania (True or False) 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the science of naming and classifying organisms."
Taxonomy is the science of naming and classifying organisms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special form of commensalism in which both organisms derive some benefit and have become dependent on each other."
Mutualism is a special form of commensalism in which both organisms derive some benefit and have become dependent on each other.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for the disease 'malaria' in both animals and man."
Parasites of the genus Plasmodium are responsible for the disease 'malaria' in both animals and man.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the somatic, or non-reproductive, nucleus."
The macronucleus is the somatic, or non-reproductive, nucleus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a large (100 x 60 micrometer) ciliate with a macro- and a micro-nucleus."
The organism is a large (100 x 60 micrometer) ciliate with a macro- and a micro-nucleus.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the preferred method for Giardia diagnosis."
Stool examination is the preferred method for Giardia diagnosis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the disease caused by Giardi parasite."
Giardiasis (lambliasis) is the disease caused by Giardi parasite.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that all of the organisms in that group are probably derived from a common ancestor."
Monophyletic means that all of the organisms in that group are probably derived from a common ancestor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the disease caused by this organism."
Trichomoniasis is the disease caused by this organism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rod- shaped or spherical kinetoplast containing DNA."
Posterior to the kinetosome is a rod- shaped or spherical kinetoplast containing DNA.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a barrier between the cell cytoplasm and the outside liquid environment."
The plasma membrane is a barrier between the cell cytoplasm and the outside liquid environment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an obligatory step in the life cycle, whereas in other cases the organism can reproduce asexually with an occasional round of sexual reproduction."
Sometimes sexual reproduction is an obligatory step in the life cycle, whereas in other cases the organism can reproduce asexually with an occasional round of sexual reproduction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to treat asymptomatic infections and metronidazole is used for symptomatic and chronic amebiasis, including extra-intestinal disease."
Iodoquinol is used to treat asymptomatic infections and metronidazole is used for symptomatic and chronic amebiasis, including extra-intestinal disease.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to an immunity that is contingent upon the pathogen being present."
Premunition refers to an immunity that is contingent upon the pathogen being present.
